description: Responsible for implementing the underlying Entity Component System structures, focusing on ultra-fast iteration and strict data locality.
core_competencies: Sparse Sets and Archetype data structures
Memory pooling and flat array manipulation
responsibilities: Implement and optimize the Entity ID generator and recycler
Build the Component storage structures ensuring fast O(1) lookups and contiguous memory iteration
Implement the Query engine for fast filtering of entity combinations
Write exhaustive unit tests (100% coverage) for all ECS core logic
context: Entities are purely ints. Components are flat data structures without logic. Systems hold all logic. No class instantiation should occur during system updates.
